title: Interop test suite: headless RFC 3977 conformance and real newsreader end-to-end
description: Build an automated interop test suite that exercises the reader daemon with unmodified newsreader clients (slrn, tin, Thunderbird) and validates RFC 3977 and RFC 5536 conformance. Tests run headlessly in CI. All RFC 3977 commands must be covered. Two-node transit propagation is included.
